Title: Generally Available: Larger SKUs for App Service Environment v3

Body.Content: Enterprises are now able to operate more securely with large SKUs to support more demanding workloads with App Service Environment v3. New Isolated v2 SKUs of 64GB/ 128GB/ 256GB provide compelling value to organizations that need a dedicated tenant to run their most sensitive and demanding applications. The SKUs are available today. Please visit this page for more information.
